battle.name: 太原之戰
battle.brief: 宣和七年（1125）秋，金人藉追究張覺事變分東、西兩路南下，粘罕領西路直趨河東，太原知府姚括據晉陽城固守。金人回回砲轟城、雲梯附城，久攻不克，遂先南下汴京迫和議；次年再攻，城破，姚括殉守。希臘火從未出現在這座城頭，猛火油櫃、火球與火砲才是當時攻城與守城用得上的燃燒兵器。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 宣和七年（1125）秋冬之交，交戰的兩方是金朝西路軍與北宋河東的守軍。金軍以左副元帥完顏宗翰為主將，漢語稱粘罕，領的是自雲中（今山西大同）一路南下的西路，與完顏宗望（斂哈）領的東路大軍分進合擊。金軍的基幹編制仍是女真舊制的猛安與謀克，五百人為一猛安，百人為一謀克；其中夾雜大量收編的遼朝降卒、漢人「漢兒」與契丹人，又有隨軍同來的回回砲手，專司操作配重投石車。糧秣、器械與攻城材料自雲中、代州一線分批輸送，越過太行山脈，北宋河東諸州被切斷在後。宋方守城的是以太原知府姚括為首的河東軍，輔以折可存等將佐，麾下有河東沿邊禁軍、弓箭手與民兵，糧食由汾河、井陘一線運入。城防、器械與民夫調配的實際決策仍歸河北西路經略司與朝廷，宣和和議割讓中山、河間、太原三鎮的旨意，就是從汴京發出、加在守軍頭上的。
countriesEn: The two sides in the autumn and winter of Xuanhe 7 (1125) were the western army of the Jin dynasty and the Song garrison of Hedong. The Jin force was commanded by the Left Vice-Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Zonghan, known in Chinese as Nihan, who led the western column down from Yunzhong (present-day Datong in Shanxi) in company with Wanyan Zongwang (Linha), commander of the eastern column; the two columns advanced in parallel with a single aim. The backbone of the Jin army remained the old Jurchen system of meng'an and mouke, five hundred men to a meng'an and a hundred to a mouke, but the ranks also held large numbers of surrendered Liao soldiers, Han troops and Khitan, together with Huihui artillery men who operated the counterweight trebuchets. Grain, ordnance and siege material moved in batches from Yunzhong and Daizhou across the Taihang range, and the Song prefectures of Hedong were cut off behind them. On the Song side the city was held by the Hedong army under Yao Kuo, administrator of Taiyuan, assisted by officers such as Zhe Kezun, with the frontier imperial guards of Hedong, archers and militia under them; grain came in along the Fen River and by the Jingxing road. The practical control of fortifications, weapons and labour draught remained with the Hebei West circuit administration and the court at Bianjing, and the decree ceding the three circuits of Zhongshan, Hejian and Taiyuan was issued from that court and laid as an extra weight on the defenders.
people: 決定這場戰役走向的是幾個名字。完顏宗翰是金太宗之子，自幼隨軍，天會三年冬自雲中南下時已是金國西路軍的主帥；他在太原城下受阻，卻沒有把主力耗在這座城上，而是轉而用外交與另一支軍隊的勝利去逼宋廷議和，最後又回頭攻下太原。他身邊的配角完顏宗望是東路主將，靖康元年正月率軍進抵汴京，迫使宋廷簽下宣和和議。北宋一端，太原知府姚括是守城的主心骨，《宋史》為他立傳，記他整頓城防、編制守軍、力拒砲擊與雲梯；靖康元年太原陷落時他與守城將士同死，史書並記其家中三十餘口一併罹難。折可存是他倚重的將佐，多次率隊出城反擊，試圖擾亂攻城部隊的集結。京城的守禦則落在李綱身上，他在靖康元年正月被任為京城守禦使，組織河北、河東的勤王兵入援，勉力保住汴京數月，只是在和議已成、割地難返的局面下被罷相。皇帝宋徽宗、宋欽宗在危局中被迫禪位與親赴軍前，康王趙構與太宰張邦昌更被金人索為人質抵押。城頭之下，扶助守軍的太原軍戶與民夫，同樣是這場戰役裡被捲入的負擔。
peopleEn: A few names decided the outcome. Wanyan Zonghan, a son of Jin Taizong who had campaigned since boyhood, was already commander of the western column when he marched south from Yunzhong in the winter of Tianhui 3 (1125); blocked beneath Taiyuan, he did not grind his main force against that city but turned instead to diplomacy and to the victories of the other column, and only later came back to take Taiyuan. Beside him Wanyan Zongwang led the eastern column, reached Bianjing in the first month of Jingkang 1 (1126) and forced the Song court into the Xuanhe peace settlement. On the Song side Yao Kuo, administrator of Taiyuan, was the heart of the defence; the History of Song devotes him a biography, recording how he reorganised the walls, drilled the garrison and held out against bombardment and ladders. When Taiyuan fell in Jingkang 1 he died with the soldiers who held the wall, and the records add that more than thirty members of his own household perished with him. Zhe Kezun was the officer he leaned on, leading sorties out of the city to disrupt the assembling of the siege. The defence of the capital fell to Li Gang, appointed commander of the capital's defence in the first month of Jingkang 1; he gathered relief troops from Hebei and Hedong and kept Bianjing standing for several months, only to be dismissed once the settlement had been signed and the ceded land could not be recovered. Emperors Song Huizong and Qinzong were forced in the crisis to abdicate and to take the field in person, and Prince Kang Zhao Gou together with Grand Chancellor Zhang Bangchang were demanded as hostages. Below the walls, the military households and labour draught of Taiyuan bore their share of the burden.
kits: 卡面上的希臘火並不在太原的城頭。希臘火是拜占庭帝國自七世紀起獨有的燃燒劑，靠人力唧筒把點火的燃油從銅管中壓出噴向目標，配方是帝國最高機密，據說隨著一批載有施放裝置的船隻沉入海底而失傳；它的戰史全部落在地中海與黑海的海戰裡，宋代金人兩份正史都不曾提到過它。真正出現在河東城頭的，是同一族群的燃燒兵器：猛火油櫃以唧筒拋射礦物油膏，火球與火砲把點火的藥料裝在陶罐或木桶內擲出，火箭把硝、硫、炭調成的藥粉壓在箭鏃上再引燃，火矢則以浸油的麻絮纏在箭上。攻城一方的主力器械是回回砲，即以配重甩臂的投石車，這種砲在遼金之際已為金人所用，太原之役是它第一次大舉壓向宋軍的城樓；配合它的還有雲梯、撞木、穴地與填壕用的木柵。守方以神臂弓、床子弩等強弩居高臨下制射攻城梯隊，並用火油與火藥燒毀貼上城牆的攻具。十二世紀上半的宋軍火藥武器仍屬雛形，霹靂砲一類爆響式的爆炸物要大約十年後才在戰場上成熟，燃燒與爆藥都沒有能改寫攻守；那一場真正壓倒宋方的，是配重投石車砸出的破口與隨後攀城的步卒。
kitsEn: The Greek fire shown on the card was never on the walls of Taiyuan. Greek fire was a burning mixture used by the Byzantine Empire alone from the seventh century onward, forced out of a copper tube by a hand pump so that the ignited fuel sprayed at its target; the formula was the empire's highest secret and is said to have been lost when the vessels carrying the siphons went down with their cargo. Its entire recorded history belongs to the naval battles of the Mediterranean and the Black Sea, and neither the Jin nor the Song official histories so much as mentions it in China. What did stand on the walls of Hedong were the same family of incendiary weapons: the menghuoyou cabinet, which flung a mineral-oil paste with a pump; fireballs and huopao, which carried ignited compounds in earthen jars or wooden tubs; fire arrows, which pressed a powder of saltpetre, sulphur and charcoal onto the head and lit it; and fire shafts whose hemp tow was soaked in oil. The principal siege instrument on the attacking side was the Huihui pao, the counterweight trebuchet, already in Jin hands from the Liao period, and Taiyuan was the first time it was thrown in earnest against a Song city tower. Working with it were ladders, battering beams, mining, and timber fillings for the ditch. The defenders answered from the walls with powerful crossbows such as the shenbi bow and the bed crossbow, shooting down the ladder teams as they closed, and set fire with oil and powder to the assault works that reached the wall. The Song gunpowder weapons of the early twelfth century were still in embryo; explosive devices of the thunder-crash type did not mature on the battlefield for roughly another decade, and neither burning nor bursting powder changed the issue. What actually broke the Song was the breach opened by the counterweight trebuchet and the foot soldiers who then climbed the wall.
tactics: 金軍的部署從一開始就是分進合擊，而不是把主力押在一座城下。完顏宗望的東路自燕京南下，攻大名、望都，控制河北；完顏宗翰的西路自雲中南下，直取太原。兩路之間的默契是：西路只要把太原的守軍釘在城裡，東路就能直趨汴京，用政治與軍事雙重壓力迫宋議和，不必先啃河東這塊硬骨頭。因此太原城下的攻城帶著明確的時限：粘罕用回回砲反覆轟擊城樓與城垛，逼宋軍把主力從四面調到受彈的一面；宋人則以弩砲遠射、拒馬與附城戰棚逐段消耗梯隊，用猛火油與火球燒毀貼城的雲梯，試圖把攻勢拖成冬季的僵持。金軍的另一手是切斷城內的糧援與援兵：汾河沿線的渡口被封，井陘方向的援軍在途中被截斷，太原城裡的存糧與柴薪逐日減少，守軍出城反擊的機會越來越少。攻城手段是配重投石車先砸城樓，再以壕溝填塞、雲梯附城、撞木撞門的次序壓上；攻城的步卒多為女真與漢軍混編的步兵，執短兵，靠城頭的火力與砲擊掩護集結。冬季的河東極寒，凍土可以通行卻難以掘取，攻方在城下紮營、填壕、備薪都要多花數倍工力，糧秣的消耗也更快，這是粘罕第一次沒有拿下太原的技術原因，也是他改用議和的現實原因。靖康元年再攻時形勢已換：金人先以砲火摧毀城防要點，再令步卒蟻附登城，守軍在糧援斷絕與城防崩壞之間失去可依托的縱深，太原遂陷。
tacticsEn: The Jin deployment was division and convergence from the outset rather than massing the main force against a single city. Wanyan Zongwang's eastern column came south through Yanjing, taking Daming and Wangdu and dominating Hebei, while Wanyan Zonghan's western column came down from Yunzhong straight upon Taiyuan. The understanding between them was that the western column only had to pin the Taiyuan garrison inside its walls so that the eastern column could drive for Bianjing and force a settlement by military and political pressure at once, without first grinding through the hard bone of Hedong. The siege therefore carried an implicit deadline. Nihan hammered the towers and parapets with the counterweight trebuchet, forcing the Song to concentrate the bulk of their strength on whichever face was under fire; the Song replied with crossbow fire, spiked barriers and fighting galleries along the wall, and destroyed ladders with oil and fireballs, trying to drag the assault out into a winter stalemate. The Jin's other move was to cut the city's supply and its relief: the fords along the Fen River were sealed, relief columns on the Jingxing road were intercepted, and inside Taiyuan the grain stores and firewood shrank day by day until the garrison had almost no chance to sortie. The actual sequence of assault was for the trebuchet to smash the towers first, then the ditch to be filled, ladders brought against the wall, and battering beams set against the gates. The assaulting foot were Jurchen and Han troops mixed, fighting with short weapons and massing under the cover of the artillery and of the fire from the walls. Winter in Hedong is bitterly cold; frozen ground can be crossed but is hard to dig, and the besiegers' camp work, ditch filling and firewood cost several times the usual labour while provisions disappeared faster. That was the technical reason Nihan could not take Taiyuan the first time, and the practical reason he preferred a negotiated settlement. When he returned in Jingkang 1 the situation had changed: the Jin broke the key points of the defence with artillery fire, then sent foot up the ladders, and with the supply line cut and the works collapsing the defenders had no depth left to hold; Taiyuan fell.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間：宣和七年（1125）秋，金人藉追究張覺事變分東、西兩路南下；西路抵達太原並開始攻城在同年秋冬；靖康元年（1126）正月，東路軍圍汴京，和議成；同年八月，西路軍破太原；靖康二年（1127）閏十一月，汴京城破。編制：金軍基幹是猛安五百人、謀克百人，太原方向投入的當在數萬之數；宋廷與私家筆記對南侵總兵力多稱百萬，屬戰前傳聞與事後誇大，可信的部分是兩路都能拉出數萬以上的騎兵與步卒。和議的條件有明確記載：黃金五百萬兩、白銀五千萬兩，割讓中山、河間、太原三鎮，並以康王趙構與太宰張邦昌為人質。城池：晉陽城郭宏大，諸史所稱周長在二十餘里上下，太原倚西北山地、東南臨汾河，西出井陘可直下河北，是河東的門戶。距離：雲中至太原約四百餘里，太原至汴京千里上下，軍報往返一趟往往在十數日。器械：宋軍城上列神臂弓、床子弩一類強弩與火藥罐具，攻城方的回回砲所擲石重數百斤，一發可毀城樓。損耗：太原城破時守軍全滅，記錄稱姚括一家三十餘口與之同死；金軍攻太原與其後南下的死傷數目，各家記載互有出入，難以核實。
dataEn: The verifiable figures run as follows. Timing: in the autumn of Xuanhe 7 (1125) the Jin used the affair of Zhang Jue as a pretext to advance in two columns, east and west; the western column reached Taiyuan and began the siege in the same autumn and winter; in the first month of Jingkang 1 (1126) the eastern column surrounded Bianjing and the settlement was signed; in the eighth month of the same year the western column took Taiyuan; in the eleventh intercalary month of Jingkang 2 (1127) Bianjing fell. Organisation: the backbone of the Jin army was the meng'an of five hundred men and the mouke of a hundred, and the force committed against Taiyuan must have numbered in the tens of thousands. Song official papers and private notes talk of a million men in the invasion, which is rumour and later exaggeration; the trustworthy part is that both columns could bring out cavalry and infantry numbering in the tens of thousands. The terms of the settlement are recorded precisely: five hundred thousand liang of gold and fifty million liang of silver, the cession of the three circuits of Zhongshan, Hejian and Taiyuan, and Prince Kang Zhao Gou with Grand Chancellor Zhang Bangchang given as hostages. The city: the walls of Jinyang were extensive, the circumferences given in the various histories clustering around twenty-odd li; Taiyuan rests against the hills to the north-west and the Fen River to the south-east, and the Jingxing road west of it leads straight down into Hebei, which is what made it the gate of Hedong. Distances: roughly four hundred-odd li from Yunzhong to Taiyuan and about a thousand li from Taiyuan to Bianjing, so a dispatch took ten-odd days each way. Equipment: the Song line carried powerful crossbows such as the shenbi bow and the bed crossbow together with fire jars, while the stones of the Huihui trebuchet weighed several hundred jin and a single shot could destroy a city tower. Losses: the garrison perished with the walls, and the records state that more than thirty members of Yao Kuo's own household died with him; the numbers of Jin dead and wounded at Taiyuan and in the campaigns that followed differ from source to source and cannot be checked.
cause: 金人南下的理由，寫在史書裡有兩層，實情比公文複雜得多。最直接的一層是藉口：北宋在海上與遼國的稱貢交涉、以及宋廷遣使往議的往事，兩國關係本就緊張；1125年遼朝降將張覺據涿州叛金，金人藉此要求宋廷交出叛將，朝廷拒絕，金軍遂以此為由分道南侵。深一層是形勢：金已滅遼，北宋收燕雲十六州不過十餘年，河北、河東的州縣多為空名，新收之地守兵不足、藩籬盡撤；金人游牧騎兵一旦南下，漢地州郡的糧秣與城垣正是最想取的目标，而童貫、蔡京用事、禁軍虛耗、內庫匱乏的北宋，已經無力在兩千餘里的戰線上同時守住每一座城。戰前宋廷對金人實力判斷錯誤，以為對方只是劫掠，必須靠外交解決；金人則認定宋廷虛弱、可速戰速決，計畫在春祭汴京之前結束戰事。宣和八年年初金人一度退兵，並不是因為戰敗，而是因為汴京沒有立刻攻下，和議的價碼才被壓到最高。
causeEn: Two layers can be distinguished in the stated reasons for the Jin advance, and the reality was more complicated than the official documents. The immediate layer is the pretext. The Song and Liao had already strained relations over the maritime tribute talks and the earlier missions sent to the Liao court; in 1125 Zhang Jue, a surrendered Liao general, rebelled at Zhuozhou, and the Jin demanded that the Song hand him over. The court refused, and the Jin used the refusal as their warrant to march south in two columns. The deeper layer is the shape of things: the Jin had destroyed the Liao, the Song had held the Sixteen Prefectures for barely a decade, and many prefectures and counties in Hebei and Hedong were names on paper only, with too few garrison troops and no stockade left in place. Once Jurchen cavalry rode south, the grain and the city walls of the Chinese districts were exactly what they wanted, while a Song court ruled by Tong Guan and Cai Jing, with hollow imperial guards and an empty internal treasury, could no longer hold every city along a front more than two thousand li long. Before the war the Song court misjudged the Jin strength, believing the raid could be settled by negotiation; the Jin judged the Song weak and ripe for a quick decision, and planned to finish before the spring sacrifices at Bianjing. When the Jin withdrew early in the first months of Xuanhe 8, it was not because they had been beaten but because Bianjing had not fallen at once, and only then was the price of peace pushed to its highest.
impact: 太原的陷落把北宋的戰局一次性推倒。北宋收復燕雲十六州之後，北方防線的安全全靠河東與河北兩道山口的城寨；太原一失，井陘、雁門兩條路同時敞開，金軍西路不必再啃任何堅城即可南下汴京，和議所買到的時間在半年之內就化為泡影，宣和八年秋天的太原陷落，與靖康二年閏十一月的汴京城破，前後只隔了一年多。割地三鎮的消息傳到中原，激起朝野的普遍反對，河北、河東的將士與州縣對朝廷的處置心寒，這份怨憤在靖康二年兩河忠義民兵的四起抗金裡以另一種形式爆發出來。技術與軍制的變化更為長久：北宋自此明白守城待援之策不足以獨活，野戰與機動作戰被提到日程上，火藥武器從守城用的爆響器皿轉向野戰用的火槍與火箭，十二世紀中葉以後的郾城、和尚原等戰役裡，突火槍與震天雷開始出現在陣前，金軍也從繳獲中吸收了中原的技術。河東的州郡此後淪陷多年，直到紹興和議才被正式割讓出去；太原則在金人手上成為西線的據點與南進的跳板。對於後世而言，這場戰役的分量不只在輸贏，而在於它明確地標示出：北宋以守城待援為核心的邊防體系，在遇上來自北方草原的、已經掌握配重投石車與騎兵機動的攻勢之前，會在幾個月的時間裡被整段突破。
impactEn: The fall of Taiyuan overturned the Song position in a single stroke. After the Song recovered the Sixteen Prefectures, the security of the northern line rested on the forts and passes of Hedong and Hebei; once Taiyuan was lost, both the Jingxing road and the Yanmen road stood open, and the Jin western column no longer had to chew through any hard city on its way to Bianjing. The time bought by the peace settlement was spent within half a year: the loss of Taiyuan in the autumn of Xuanhe 8 and the fall of Bianjing in the eleventh intercalary month of Jingkang 2 were separated by barely more than a year. The news of the three cessions stirred widespread opposition in the court and the country, and the officers and prefectures of Hebei and Hedong were cold toward the court's handling of the matter; that resentment surfaced in another form in the rising of loyalist bands in the two rivers during Jingkang 2. The changes in technique and organisation proved longer-lived. The Song now understood that waiting behind walls for relief was not enough to survive on its own; field operations and manoeuvre were put on the agenda, and gunpowder weapons moved from explosive jars used in defence to guns and rockets used in the field, appearing before the line in the fighting of the mid-twelfth century, while the Jin absorbed Chinese techniques from captured stores. The prefectures of Hedong remained in Jin hands for years and were formally ceded only at the peace of Shaoxing; Taiyuan became a western base and a springboard for a further southern advance. For later generations the significance of the battle lay less in its result than in what it demonstrated: a Song defensive system built on holding walls until relief came would be broken through along its whole length within months when it met an enemy from the northern steppe who already had the counterweight trebuchet and cavalry manoeuvre.
result: 結果要分兩段看。宣和七年冬天，粘罕對太原的第一次進攻沒有成功：砲擊、雲梯與火攻都沒能讓城破，金軍最終退兵，宋朝以割讓三鎮、支付金銀並交出人質換得暫時的停戰。但代價在半年內兌現：靖康元年八月，金人再攻太原，這一次宋軍已經沒有可以倚靠的援軍與糧道，城破，姚括與守城將士殉難，一門三十餘口同死，河東的門戶自此大開。金軍西路隨即沿井陘南下，與東路會合；靖康二年閏十一月，汴京在圍攻一月後陷落，徽、欽二帝與大批皇族、官員被俘北上，北宋亡國，康王趙構於應天府即位，是為宋高宗，宋室南渡建立南宋。太原因此成為靖康之變的轉折點：它既是第一次南侵沒有被攻破的城，也是把北宋的失敗從外交與賠款推成全面崩潰的那道缺口。對宋的將領而言，這場戰役留下的教訓被寫進了後來的軍議：僅靠城牆、砲石與忠勇不足以守住河東，糧道與援軍的組織方式，才真正決定一座要塞的存亡。
resultEn: The result has to be read in two stages. In the winter of Xuanhe 7 Nihan's first attack on Taiyuan failed: bombardment, ladders and fire alike could not bring the walls down, and the Jin finally withdrew, while the Song bought a temporary truce by ceding three circuits, paying out gold and silver and handing over hostages. The price fell due within half a year. In the eighth month of Jingkang 1 the Jin returned to Taiyuan, and this time the Song had no relief column and no supply road left to lean on; the city fell, Yao Kuo died with the garrison that held the wall, and more than thirty of his household perished with him. The gate of Hedong stood open from that moment. The Jin western column rode down the Jingxing road and joined the eastern column; in the eleventh intercalary month of Jingkang 2, after a siege of a month, Bianjing fell, the two emperors and a great part of the imperial clan and the officials were carried north in captivity, the Northern Song ceased to exist, and Prince Kang Zhao Gou took the throne at Yingtian and became Emperor Gaozong, founding the Southern Song. Taiyuan was therefore the turning point of the Jingkang disaster: the city that had not fallen in the first invasion, and the breach that turned the Song failure from a matter of diplomacy and indemnity into a general collapse. For the Song commanders the lesson was entered into later military discussions: walls, stones and courage alone could not hold Hedong; the organisation of supply lines and relief was what decided whether a fortress survived.
